signals.architecture_freetext: Samsung unveiled three-stage custom HBM roadmap at Hot Chips 2026: memory controller migration to base die (4nm), Heat Path Block (HPB) technology reducing peak temperatures 35%, and zHBM eliminating interposer via direct stacking on XPU with 70% power reduction and 100W GPU compute headroom. zHBM requires 6μm hybrid bonding and integrated memory-SoC design.
